messages.subject: Maliha | GCC Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Jilani,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC and international leadership mandates where government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and country-facing leadership intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, external affairs, corporate reputation, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your leadership of Heidrick & Struggles in MENA, together with your work across social impact, government, policy, multinationals and family groups, makes this a strong fit for confidential consideration.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director, Country Representative and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Strategic Partnerships and related leadership functions. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE and wider region.

I have attached a GCC-focused executive CV. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
